title: What the Rain Keeps
poem: i.  I keep an inventory of tendernesses meant for someone else.
ii.  I counted my breaths to be sure they were mine. The number changes.
iii.  I remember a room I have never stood in. The light there is always late.
iv.  Each morning I assemble the same face and hope it holds till dark.
v.  They tell me the rain is only weather. Then why does it knock to be let in.
colophon: a symmetry that almost holds, and the light that finds where it doesn't.
